name: c12c-check
description: Step C12c books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, the default springs plus springs of every kind, the uphill swaps x15 (more excited waste), N (60 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s), G (200 s), a resize back (220 s), new springs (240 s), the excited waste, its look, lifetime, grazing, lipids and the membrane chemistry off and on at runtime (255 to 350 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (380 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.65, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.7, v.cssH * 0.65, 'emulsion', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); return moire.matter.springs.length
await moire.genome.setAll({ wall: 0.8, wallRow: 0.5, oilShare: 0.5 }, { cells: Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, k) => 4 * k) }); return 'a quarter of the slots walled and oily'
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'soap', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'linker', 200); return 1

{ const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'emulsion'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.7, 'soap'); } return moire.matter.springs.length
moire.excited.params.on = true; moire.excited.look.on = false; return 'excited on, look off'
moire.excited.params.life = 30; moire.excited.params.hot = 4; moire.lipids.params.graze = false; return 'graze off'
moire.lipids.params.graze = true; moire.lipids.params.on = false; return 'lipids off'
moire.lipids.params.on = true; moire.membrane.params.on = false; return 'membrane chemistry off'
moire.membrane.params.on = true; moire.eat.params.engines = false; return 'engines off'
moire.eat.params.engines = true; moire.matter.chem.on = false; return 'chemistry off'
